For the Petitioner : Mr. Pankaj Srivastava, Advocate For the State : Mr. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P. For O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Kumar Saurav, Advocate -----

Oral Order 13 / Dated : 12.01.2024 I.A. No. 9178 of 2022 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner in this interlocutory application which has been filed for exempting the petitioner from surrendering before the court below.

The petitioner has been convicted by the trial court under Section 498A of Indian Penal Code and the same has been affirmed in Cr. Appeal No. 09 of 2021 against which the instant revision petition has been preferred.

The main ground for exemption from surrendering the court below is that the dispute between both sides has been amicably resolved which has come in the order passed by the Principal Sessions Judge, Jamtara in Cr. Appeal No. 36 of 2017 which was preferred against the order passed by the C.J.M., Jamtara in Domestic Violence Case No. 15 of 2015.
Learned counsel for the State as well as opposite party no. 2 have opposed the interlocutory application.
